versions.changelog:
Initial release of AI大模型专家｜GEO 生成式引擎优化 (v1.0.0):

- Introduces a generative engine optimization skill tailored for drama, manga, e-commerce, marketing, and AI search teams, supporting content planning, evidence fields, and generative tasks.
- Provides structured workflows for search intent analysis, content decomposition, storyboarding, visual/scene continuity, and Q&A/explanation generation.
- Enables multi-platform, multi-format output (images, videos, scripts) suitable for domestic and overseas short drama platforms.
- Integrates with AI-HIVE, supporting unified access to image/video models, batch task processing, real-time configuration, cost control, and result tracking.
- Features practical code examples for blueprint generation, structured Q&A, media asset generation, and search visibility auditing.
- Emphasizes data security, copyright compliance, workflow transparency, and scalable adaptation for commercial delivery.
